entries.source: Torques are made by powerful psionics to store psionic powers.
entries.target: 项圈由强大的灵能者制造，用来储存灵能。

entries.source: Natural totems are made by powerful wilders to store nature power.
entries.target: 自然图腾是由自然守护者们制造，用以储存自然能量的。

entries.source: Magical wands are made by powerful Alchemists and Archmagi to store spells. Anybody can use them to release the spells.
entries.target: 魔杖由强大的炼金术师和大法师制造，用于储存法术。任何人都可以用它释放其中的法术。

entries.source: A pointy cloth hat, very wizardly...
entries.target: 一顶法师风格的尖帽子……

entries.source: When attacking in melee, deals 15 light damage and lights tiles in radius 1.
entries.target: 近战攻击时，在1格半径内造成15光系伤害并照亮区域。

entries.source: Damage all enemies in range 4 for 40 fire damage and yourself for 5 fire damage every turn.
entries.target: 每回合对周围4格范围内的敌人造成40火焰伤害，对你自己造成5火焰伤害。

entries.source: attempt to destroy all magic effects and sustains on creatures in a radius %d cone (unnatural creatures are additionally dealt %0.2f arcane damage and stunned)
entries.target: 在半径%d格锥形范围内尝试驱散生物身上的魔法效果和魔法持续技能（至多两项；非自然生物还会额外受到%0.2f奥术伤害并被震慑）

entries.source: Creates an arcane explosion dealing %d arcane damage based on magic in a radius of 3 around the user after any teleport.
entries.target: 使用者传送后，在周围3格范围内引发奥术爆发，造成%d奥术伤害，伤害基于魔力值。

entries.source: phase door up to range 6, within radius 2 of the target location
entries.target: 传送到6格范围内的地点，误差在两格范围内。

entries.source: release absorbed darkness in a %d radius cone with a %d%% chance to blind (based on lite radius), dealing %0.2f darkness damage (based on Mindpower and charge)
entries.target: 在%d格的锥形范围内释放吸收的黑暗，有 %d%% 几率致盲（基于光照半径），并造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害（基于精神强度和吸收量）

entries.source: call forth an immobile antimagic pillar for 10 turns.  (It spits slime, pulls in, stuns, and burns the arcane resources of your foes, while emitting an aura of silence against them within range 5, and will silence you for 5 turns when first summoned.)
entries.target: 召唤一个无法移动的反魔石柱 10 回合。（它可以喷吐史莱姆、拉拽、震慑并燃烧敌人的奥术资源，同时在5格范围内对它们施放沉默光环，并且首次召唤时会沉默你5回合。）

entries.source: release a radius %d burst of void energy at up to range %d, dealing %0.2f temporal and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic)
entries.target: 释放一片半径 %d 的虚空能量爆发，最远可及 %d 格距离，造成 %0.2f 时空和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。（基于魔力）

entries.source: A deep red light glows from within this damaged amulet of black stone. When you touch it, you can hear voices whispering within your mind.
entries.target: 这条破损的黑石项链内透出暗红色的光芒，当你触摸它时，你能听到脑海里的窃窃私语。

entries.source: These titanic boots appear to have been carved from stone. They appear weathered and cracked, but easily deflect all blows.
entries.target: 这对巨大的靴子似乎是用石头雕刻而成的，尽管已经风化破裂，但仍能轻易挡开一切打击。

entries.source: These heavy stone gauntlets make the very ground beneath you bend and warp as they move.
entries.target: 这双沉重的石质手套移动时，会使你脚下的大地随之扭曲变形。

entries.source: summon a stationary shining orb within range %d for 15 turns that will illuminate its area and deal %d light damage (based on your Magic and Strength) to your foes within radius %d each turn
entries.target: 在 %d 格范围内召唤一个静止的发光球体，持续15回合，照亮其周围区域，并每回合对半径 %d 内的敌人造成 %d 光系伤害（基于魔力和力量）

entries.source: Sends a tremor through the ground which causes jagged rocks to erupt in a beam of length 5, dealing %d Physical damage (equal to your Strength, up to 150) and causing targets hit to bleed for an additional 50 damage over 5 turns. Bleeding can stack.
entries.target: 使大地震颤裂开，露出尖石，在5格直线上造成%d物理伤害（与你的力量值相等，最高150），并使击中的目标流血，在5回合内额外造成50伤害。流血伤害可以叠加。

entries.source: releases a burst of light, dealing %d light damage (based on Spellpower) in a radius 3 cone.
entries.target: 放出光系爆炸，在3格扇形区域内造成%d光系伤害（基于法术强度）。

entries.source: A cautionary tale tells of the ancient warlock by the name of Caim, who fancied himself daily walks through Goedalath, both to test himself and the harsh demonic wastes. He was careful to never bring anything back with him, lest it provide a beacon for the demons to find him. Unfortunately, over time, his sandals drenched in the soot and ashes of the fearscape and the fire followed his footsteps outside, drawing in the conclusion of his grim fate.
entries.target: 这是一个警示故事，讲的是有个叫凯姆的古代术士，他喜欢每天到恶魔的老巢高达勒斯散步，既为考验自己，也为考验那片严酷的恶魔荒原。他每次从恶魔位面归来都小心翼翼地不敢带回任何东西，生怕成为恶魔找到他的指引。不幸的是，来回很多次以后，他的凉鞋浸满了恶魔空间的烟尘和灰烬。火焰随他的脚步被带到了世间，同时也注定了他悲惨的命运。

entries.source: A small storm cloud follows you, dealing 15 lightning damage to all enemies in a radius of 3 each turn.
entries.target: 一团小小的风暴云跟随着你，每回合对周围3格内的敌人造成15闪电伤害。
